Example Single-Environment BLUE Table

Source: R/example_data.R
gs_example_blues_single.Rd

One simulated stage-1 BLUE per genotype for `gblup_cv_single.R`. BLUEs are inverse-variance combinations of the available environment-specific values. Some `Weight` entries are deliberately missing while `SE` remains available, exercising the script's documented `1 / SE^2` fallback.

Usage

gs_example_blues_single

Format

A data frame with 120 rows and five columns:

GenoID

Genotype identifier matching the GRM.

NBL

Simulated quantitative-trait BLUE.

Population

Supplied cross-validation stratum (`P1` to `P3`).

SE

Standard error of the BLUE.

Weight

BLUE precision weight; normally the inverse variance.

Source

Generated by `data-raw/generate_example_data.R`.

Examples

data(gs_example_blues_single)
head(gs_example_blues_single)
#>   GenoID     NBL Population     SE   Weight
#> 1   G001  9.3100         P2 0.1931 26.80846
#> 2   G002  9.9682         P1 0.1894 27.88982
#> 3   G003  8.8982         P2 0.2032 24.21563
#> 4   G004  8.4898         P3 0.1944 26.45911
#> 5   G005 11.7996         P3 0.2303 18.85563
#> 6   G006  9.2871         P2 0.2033 24.19103
sum(is.na(gs_example_blues_single$Weight))
#> [1] 6
